items.title: 68426_Nellie Lutcher oral history interview
items.q: Leon and Otis René, were very marvelous musicians, song writers. And very successful, very successful.

ctx.x: Well, Leon and Otis were very successful, you know, musicians. They wrote some wonderful things. Leon, incidentally, wrote that swallows, "The Swallows Come Back to Capistrano," and they wrote, "Sleepy Time Down South," and I think Clarence Muse (INSONIC) got in on that, but they were, I think, the real writers of it, you know. But Clarence did it and featured it and, you know, sold it for them. So -- he gets credit for that, you know. But -- (Recording interruption)
Okay, you were talking about the René brothers. Go on.

Leon and Otis René, were very marvelous musicians, song writers. And very successful, very successful. They did, "Sleepy Time Down South," and they did -- in later years Leon, I think -- I don't know if the both of them wrote it, but I know Leon wrote Swallows, "When the Swallows Come Back to Capistrano," and many other things, marvelous things. And I remember my aunt, Augusta Glover, who was my husband's aunt,

items.title: 68426_Nellie Lutcher oral history interview
items.q: my aunt said to me, she says, 'You know, I'm -- I want Mr. René, I want you to meet Mr. René, Mr. Leon Renéey.'

ctx.x: Well, in some instances I have been told this. But, as I say, it depends on how they, you know, what the contract is, and of course this all goes back to a union thing. By the time -- you see, by the time all this happened, naturally I was into the union, you see, thanks to Paul Howard, got me involved in -- well, I had been in the union years, because I had been out here quite awhile when this all happened. So it was quite a marvelous thing. However, I must say that when it did -- when the opportunity did come,…

get excited, I wasn't excited, you know, because I had been promised -- I had had interviews and I had spoken to people and been recommended to people. But none of this happened -- it didn't happen when I expected it to happen. You understand what I'm saying? So for instance, one guy who is a friend of mine, Leon Rainey. You know the René brothers, Leon and Otis René?
